tokens.name: oak-900
tokens.usage: Page background on every screen. The tavern at night.

tokens.name: oak-800
tokens.usage: Raised wooden panels: the party bar, bottom sheets, input fields.

tokens.name: oak-700
tokens.usage: Wooden tiles and secondary buttons sitting on oak-800 or oak-900.

tokens.name: oak-600
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines and dividers between wooden panels. Not for borders that carry meaning (use edge).

tokens.name: edge
tokens.usage: Borders that carry meaning on wood: text fields, unselected tiles. 3.8:1 on oak-800, 4.3:1 on oak-900.

tokens.name: parchment-100
tokens.usage: Parchment cards: story lines, choice cards, quest cards, end-screen summary. Anything players read aloud.

tokens.name: parchment-200
tokens.usage: Pressed parchment and older story lines that have already been read.

tokens.name: parchment-300
tokens.usage: Decorative edge and torn-paper rule on parchment cards. Never text.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Text on parchment-100 (13.4:1), parchment-200 (11.4:1) and candle-500 (8.8:1).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on parchment-100 (6.3:1) and parchment-200 (5.3:1): reader names, hints. Also the selected border on parchment.

tokens.name: cream
tokens.usage: Text on oak-900 (15.5:1), oak-800 and oak-700, and on wax-600, class fills.

tokens.name: cream-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on oak-900 (9.2:1), oak-800 (8.1:1) and oak-700 (6.8:1): captions, helper text.

tokens.name: candle-500
tokens.usage: Main buttons, the active hero, HP fill, success. One candle-gold button per screen.

tokens.name: candle-600
tokens.usage: Pressed state of candle-500 buttons.

tokens.name: candle-300
tokens.usage: Focus ring, Natural 20 glow and rays. 11.7:1 on oak-800.

tokens.name: on-candle
tokens.usage: Text and icons on candle-500 and candle-300.

tokens.name: wax-600
tokens.usage: Red wax: danger fills, low HP, defeat banner, Natural 1. Cream text on it (6.2:1).

tokens.name: wax-400
tokens.usage: Danger text on wood: damage numbers, 'Knocked out' on oak-900 (6.3:1) and oak-800 (5.6:1).

tokens.name: on-wax
tokens.usage: Text on wax-600.

tokens.name: knight
tokens.usage: Knight (STR) ember red fill: monogram disc, class badge. Cream text on it (5.0:1).

tokens.name: knight-bright
tokens.usage: Knight colour as text, rings and bars on oak-800 (6.4:1) and oak-900.

tokens.name: thief
tokens.usage: Thief (DEX) forest green fill. Cream text on it (5.0:1).

tokens.name: thief-bright
tokens.usage: Thief colour as text, rings and bars on oak-800 (8.1:1) and oak-900.

tokens.name: wizard
tokens.usage: Wizard (INT) arcane blue fill. Cream text on it (4.9:1).

tokens.name: wizard-bright
tokens.usage: Wizard colour as text, rings and bars on oak-800 (7.3:1) and oak-900.

tokens.name: jester
tokens.usage: Jester (CHA) magenta fill. Cream text on it (5.1:1).

tokens.name: jester-bright
tokens.usage: Jester colour as text, rings and bars on oak-800 (6.8:1) and oak-900.

tokens.name: on-class
tokens.usage: Text on the four class fills.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring on every interactive element, on wood and on parchment.

styles.name: title-xl
styles.usage: Screen titles: the game name, Victory, Defeat, Natural 20. One per screen.

styles.name: title-lg
styles.usage: Step titles: party setup, quest board.

styles.name: title-md
styles.usage: Quest names on cards and in the story header.

styles.name: die-number
styles.usage: The number on the d20 face. Nothing else.

styles.name: story-lead
styles.usage: The line being read aloud right now.

styles.name: story
styles.sample: A goose in a tiny hat blocks the bakery door.
styles.usage: Story lines and choice text. Never smaller on a phone.

styles.name: story-small
styles.sample: You found: one slightly damp map.
styles.usage: Already-read lines, item notes, end-screen recap.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Hero names, field labels, turn prompts.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Secondary info: turn count, reader name.

styles.name: tag
styles.usage: Stat and difficulty tags, class stat. Uppercase.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Between a tag and its text.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside chips and badges; gap between HP bar and name.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between stacked cards.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen side gutter and card padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Between sections of a screen.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Above screen titles; around the die.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: End-screen breathing room.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Tags and small badges.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Parchment cards, text fields, tiles.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Buttons, bottom sheets, the dice tray.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: HP bars, monogram discs, the reader chip.

tokens.name: tap-min
tokens.usage: Minimum height of anything tappable.

tokens.name: tap-lg
tokens.usage: Main button height (Roll for it, Start the quest).

tokens.name: screen-max
tokens.usage: Max content width. One column, centred, on every screen.

tokens.name: hp-bar
tokens.usage: HP bar height in the party bar.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Parchment cards resting on wood.

tokens.name: shadow-press
tokens.usage: The chunky bottom lip on buttons; removed when pressed.

tokens.name: shadow-glow
tokens.usage: Natural 20, the active hero, and the candle button's focus.
